# SemiconFab.org

> Open Semiconductor Fab Digital Twin Platform — Source-available 300mm (12-inch) advanced wafer fabrication cleanroom, equipment taxonomy, SEMI telemetry, and yield analytics.

SemiconFab.org provides a browser-based, high-fidelity 2D/3D digital twin of a 300mm semiconductor wafer fabrication facility. It bridges cleanroom architectural engineering, subfab MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) piping infrastructure, 92+ equipment classifications, real-time SECS/GEM and SEMI E10 industrial telemetry, and microscopic yield management.

## Key Technical Specifications & Architectural Standards

- **Wafer Geometry**: 300mm (12-inch) single-crystal silicon wafer standard, SEMI M1 notch orientation, 775 µm nominal thickness.
- **Cleanroom Specification**: ISO 14644-1 Class 1 (US FED STD 209E Class 1), < 10 particles (≥ 0.1 µm) per m³.
- **Cleanroom Elevation**:
  - Level 1 (L1) Process Cleanroom: 4.5m ceiling height, Class 1 unidirectional laminar air flow, raised perforated waffle slab (600mm × 600mm tiles).
  - Basment (B1) Subfab Utility Plenum: 6.0m clear height, Class 10,000 / ISO 7, housing vacuum dry pumps, RF plasma generators, scrubbers, and chemical dispense units.
  - Plenums: FFU (Fan Filter Unit) recirculation plenum (+20m relative) with ULPA filters (99.9995% efficiency @ 0.12 µm).
- **Subfab MEP Utility Loops**:
  - UPW (Ultra-Pure Water): 18.2 MΩ·cm resistivity, TOC < 1 ppb.
  - Specialty Gases: Silane (SiH4), Ammonia (NH3), Nitrogen Trifluoride (NF3), Arsine (AsH3), Phosphine (PH3), Chlorine (Cl2), Hydrogen Chloride (HCl).
  - Bulk Gases: Ultra-high-purity N2, O2, Ar, H2, He.
  - Vacuum: Roughing dry pumps + turbomolecular secondary pumps (HV/UHV down to 10^-7 Torr).
  - Exhaust Systems: Acid exhaust (scrubbed), solvent/VOC exhaust (thermal oxidizers), toxic exhaust, heat exhaust.
- **Equipment Taxonomy**: 92+ equipment classifications across 8 primary front-end-of-line (FEOL) and back-end-of-line (BEOL) module types:
  1. Photolithography (EUV 13.5nm, ArFi 193nm Immersion, ArF Dry, KrF 248nm, i-Line 365nm)
  2. Photoresist Processing / Track (Coater / Developer with bake and chill plates)
  3. Dry Etching (RIE, ICP, CCP, Atomic Layer Etch ALE)
  4. Thin Film Deposition (PECVD, LPCVD, ALD, PVD Magnetron Sputter, ECD Electroplating)
  5. Wet Chemical Processing (Single-wafer spin clean, RCA batch wet benches)
  6. Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP with slurry dispense, polishing pads, post-CMP cleaners)
  7. Thermal Processing & Doping (Vertical diffusion furnace, RTP Rapid Thermal Processing, High/Medium Current Ion Implantation)
  8. Metrology & Inspection (CD-SEM, Defect Review SEM, Ellipsometry, Brightfield/Darkfield Optical Inspection)
- **Industrial Standards & Telemetry**:
  - SEMI E10: RAM metrics (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability; MTBF, MTTR, Productive, Standby, Engineering, Unscheduled Down states).
  - SEMI E30 (GEM) & SEMI E37 (HSMS): Equipment-to-host communications, SVID, CEID, alarm reporting.
  - STDF (Standard Test Data Format) V4: Datalog parsing for sort/parametric wafer test.
  - Yield Modeling: Poisson yield model `Y = exp(-D0 * A)` and Murphy yield model `Y = ((1 - exp(-D0 * A)) / (D0 * A))^2`.
  - WM-811K Benchmark: 8 spatial defect signatures (Center, Donut, Edge-Loc, Edge-Ring, Loc, Random, Scratch, Near-Full).

## Primary Platform Pages & Entry Points

- [Platform Homepage](https://semiconfab.org/): Interactive 300mm silicon wafer 3D view, core capabilities breakdown, technology stack, and platform FAQ.
- [3D Cleanroom Digital Twin System](https://semiconfab.org/twin): Full interactive WebGL 3D cleanroom with real-time equipment inspection, exploded view, dynamic section clipping, MEP X-ray piping visualization, SECS/GEM telemetry streaming, and WM-811K wafer map defect analyzer.
- [Open Initiative Vision & 6 Pillars](https://semiconfab.org/vision): Technical whitepaper detailing the open architectural vision across 6 pillars: Open CAD Specs, Standard Process Recipes, SECS/GEM Telemetry, AI Yield Engine, Immersive Education, and Global Fab Benchmarking.

## 3D Advanced Semiconductor Device Fabrication Digital Twins

SemiconFab.org provides interactive 10-step 3D CAD fabrication digital twins for leading-edge transistor and memory architectures, modeling sequential material deposition, lithography, atomic-precision etching, CMP, and metallization:

1. **FinFET 3D Transistor Fabrication Digital Twin** (`https://semiconfab.org/finfet.html` / `https://semiconfab.org/finfet`):
   - **Architecture**: 14nm/7nm Tri-Gate FinFET with Replacement Metal Gate (RMG / Gate-Last) process flow.
   - **Key Steps**: Single-crystal Si substrate well doping, SADP (Self-Aligned Double Patterning) fin pitch splitting, STI oxide gap fill & recess (40nm fin height release), dummy polysilicon gate patterning, low-k SiOCN/SiBCN inner spacers, diamond-faceted embedded SiGe (pFET) source/drain epitaxy with uniaxial channel strain, ILD0 CMP planarization, sacrificial gate wet strip, and HfO2/TiN/W High-k Metal Gate (HKMG) ALD metallization.

2. **GAAFET 3D Nanosheet Transistor Fabrication Digital Twin** (`https://semiconfab.org/gaa.html` / `https://semiconfab.org/gaa`):
   - **Architecture**: Sub-3nm/2nm Gate-All-Around (GAAFET / MBCFET / RibbonFET) multi-bridge horizontal nanosheet architecture.
   - **Key Steps**: P/N-well silicon substrate, atomic-layer Si/Si0.7Ge0.3 alternating superlattice epitaxy (3-4 pairs), EUV nanosheet fin dry etch, STI recess, dummy poly gate patterning, selective isotropic SiGe lateral cavity recess & low-k inner spacer formation (parasitic Cgd reduction), faceted S/D selective epitaxy, ILD0 CMP, selective SiGe vapor phase nanosheet release (selectivity > 150:1), and 360-degree all-around HfO2/TiN/W HKMG gate wrapping.

3. **DRAM 1T1C Memory Cell Fabrication Digital Twin** (`https://semiconfab.org/dram.html` / `https://semiconfab.org/dram`):
   - **Architecture**: 6F² DRAM 1-Transistor 1-Capacitor cell with Buried Wordlines (b-WL) and >40:1 MIM cylinder storage capacitors.
   - **Key Steps**: 6F² diagonal active silicon islands with STI isolation, Buried Wordline (b-WL / BCAT) saddle-fin trench dry etch, thermal gate oxide + TiN/W gate fill with SiN protective capping, Bitline Direct Contact (DC) self-aligned etch & N+ poly plug, poly-Si/W bitline stack patterning & SiBCN spacers, Storage Node Contact (SNC) etch & hexagonal landing pads, 1.4μm thick sacrificial mold oxide with dual Si3N4 supporter membranes, cryogenic HAR (>40:1) deep hole punch etch, mold oxide selective wet strip with freestanding TiN cylinder release, and ALD MIM ZAZ (ZrO2/Al2O3/ZrO2) High-k dielectric (k~38) with top plate metallization.

4. **3D NAND Charge Trap Flash (CTF) Memory Fabrication Digital Twin** (`https://semiconfab.org/nand.html` / `https://semiconfab.org/nand`):
   - **Architecture**: Vertical multi-tier Charge Trap Flash (CTF / BiCS) string with hollow Macaroni channel and Replacement Gate wordlines.
   - **Key Steps**: P-well substrate & N+ poly/WSi bottom common source plate, alternating PECVD oxide-nitride (SiO2/Si3N4) multi-layer superlattice stack deposition, extreme cryogenic HAR (>60:1) vertical channel hole punch etch, ALD conformal ONO charge trap dielectric (Al2O3 blocking + Si3N4 trap + SiO2 tunnel), thin poly-Si vertical conduction channel & insulating SiO2 core ('Macaroni') fill with top N+ drain plug, deep wordline slit trench (Gate Cut) dry etch, hot phosphoric acid (H3PO4, ~160°C) selective sacrificial nitride strip releasing lateral gate galleries, ALD TiN barrier + CVD Tungsten (W) wordline replacement metallization, slit sidewall SiO2 spacers + solid Tungsten Common Source Line (CSL) vertical wall, and dual-damascene orthogonal Bitline (BL) metallization.

5. **HBM3E / HBM4 3D Memory Stacking & Advanced Packaging Digital Twin** (`https://semiconfab.org/hbm.html` / `https://semiconfab.org/hbm`):
   - **Architecture**: 8-Hi / 12-Hi / 16-Hi High Bandwidth Memory cube with vertical TSVs, dense microbumps, and 2.5D CoWoS host GPU heterogeneous integration.
   - **Key Steps**: CMOS Logic Base/Buffer Die fabrication with 1024-bit DFI PHY & BIST testing, DRAM core wafer high-density blind TSV DRIE & void-free ECD copper fill, front-side fine-pitch Cu RDL & microbump metallization (Cu pillar + Sn-Ag cap), temporary optical carrier wafer bonding, extreme backside mechanical diamond grinding & stress-relief CMP (~30-45μm), selective SF6 TSV tip reveal etch & low-temp passivation, backside UBM sputtering & 308nm excimer laser debonding into Known Good Dies (KGD), high-precision sub-micron 3D vertical die stacking via TC-NCF / MR-MUF, vacuum epoxy molding compound (EMC) encapsulation with top-die bare silicon heat dissipation polish, and 2.5D Silicon Interposer CoWoS integration alongside host GPU compute processor.

## Canonical Data Endpoints

- `/catalog.json`: Canonical 167-record equipment catalog dataset.
- `/schema.json`: Schema v1.0 machine-readable equipment specification JSON schema.
- `/benchmark/routes.json`: MIMAC-2026 300mm manufacturing process route definitions.
